name: Koganei (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Koganei city emblem in red: a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised flame-like bud.
history: Municipal flag of Koganei, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1958.

features.role: Koganei city emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing a stylised flame-like bud
